description: Build one valid SPF TXT record for a domain from the services that send its email (e.g. microsoft365, google, mailchimp, sendgrid, website). Optionally reads the domain's current SPF record and MX first (keeps unknown entries, warns about services it would drop), adds extra IPs/includes, and counts DNS lookups live against the 10-lookup limit. Returns the record, DNS name, lookup count, notes and a starter DMARC record. Service ids: microsoft365, google, zoho, proton, fastmail, icloud, mimecast_za, mimecast, website, mx, shopify, mailchimp, mandrill, brevo, mailerlite, constantcontact, campaignmonitor, mailjet, sendpulse, sendgrid, mailgun, amazonses, postmark, zendesk, freshdesk, helpscout, salesforce.

domain.description: Optional domain to read the current record from

name: generate_spf_record
